name: Korea Line Corporation
summary: Korea Line Corporation engages in the provision of dedicated, tramper, and tanker carrier services worldwide. The company transports various types of cargo, including iron ore, coal, grain, cement, fertilizer, steel, clean petroleum products, etc. Its owned fleets consist of 24 Vessels, which include 20 bulk, 3 MR tankers, and 1 PCTC with a total of 3,416,382 DWT. The company was founded in 1968 and is based in Seoul, South Korea. Korea Line Corporation operates as a subsidiary of Samra Midas Group.
